capabilities: Auto-exports tldraw drawings as transparent SVG and PNG on save
Writes exported images beside the editable drawing file
Skips manually edited, preexisting, or synced images using checksums
Keeps prior images at old paths when a source is renamed
disambiguation: Not a drawing editor; it only auto-exports tldraw drawings as SVG/PNG and requires the tldraw plugin installed.
extras: Desktop-only; the drawing must stay focused in its own tab until it saves, and checksums stored in Obsidian local storage may cause edited or synced images to be skipped.
intentEvidence: It uses the renderer in the installed plugin to save transparent SVG and PNG images beside your editable drawings.
problem: Getting a static SVG or PNG out of a tldraw drawing is a manual step, so embedded image copies go stale whenever the drawing changes.

relations.evidence: The companion uses the tldraw plugin's internal live editor interface.

summary: Desktop companion that automatically exports tldraw drawings as transparent SVG and PNG files beside the editable source.
